title: Mlai entry scenario spam metric choice
topic: Mlai entry scenario spam metric choice
question: Given this setup, which evaluation metric or metrics would you prioritize, and why would plain accuracy be a bad choice here?
idealAnswer:
The classes are heavily imbalanced (2% spam), so a model that always predicts 'not spam' would get 98% accuracy while being completely useless, accuracy is misleading here

Since flagged emails go to a human reviewer rather than being auto-deleted, missing some spam is more tolerable than in an auto-delete system, but recall still matters so spam doesn't slip through unreviewed

Precision matters too, because flagging too many legitimate emails wastes the reviewer's time and could make them distrust the system

A precision-recall curve or F1 score is more informative than accuracy in this imbalanced setting

A strong answer proposes looking at the confusion matrix directly, not just a single summary number, to understand the actual error tradeoffs
